name: t1d-cpd-benchmark-datasets
description: Collection of benchmark datasets for evaluating blood-glucose forecasting and control methods for people with type 1 diabetes. It includes time-series data (continuous glucose monitoring, insulin dosing, meals/activity) and is intended to measure predictive accuracy and control-policy performance. Common uses are comparing forecasting models and closed-loop control algorithms on clinically relevant metrics.
reputation: Specialized medical benchmark with interest from diabetes ML and control communities; moderate adoption in academic research.
